FROM fact_return_line f

INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.category = 'Garden'

  AND d.fiscal_period = 4

SELECT SUM(quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4

SELECT COUNT(*) as return_line_count, SUM(quantity_returned) as total_units
FROM fact_return_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4

SELECT quantity_returned, COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_return_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY quantity_returned
ORDER BY quantity_returned

SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
